marketLayer.title: US Megacap Tech & Semiconductor Momentum
marketLayer.fact: NVIDIA and US semiconductor peers extended gains following strong cloud infrastructure demand signals, while Big Tech firms reaffirmed elevated 2026 AI capital expenditure plans.
marketLayer.inference: Short-term momentum favors AI hardware supply chains, supporting sustained earnings growth expectations for North American technology indices.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Potential margin compression if monetization timelines for enterprise AI applications lag aggressive capex commitments.

marketLayer.title: HK Tech & Chinese Internet Platform Dynamics
marketLayer.fact: The Hang Seng Tech Index consolidated near key technical resistance as major internet giants including Tencent and Alibaba executed ongoing daily share buybacks.
marketLayer.inference: Corporate buybacks provide a resilient valuation floor, though broader upside remains reliant on clearer macroeconomic recovery metrics in domestic consumer spending.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Persisting structural headwinds in domestic consumption and geopolitical regulatory scrutiny regarding cross-border technology transfers.

marketLayer.title: Federal Reserve Monetary Policy & Treasury Yield Movements
marketLayer.fact: US 10-year Treasury yields stabilized around 4.15% as recent economic indicators signaled moderate labor market cooling alongside persistent core inflation sticky points.
marketLayer.inference: Markets continue to price in a gradual rate-cutting path, keeping global equity valuations supported while limiting rapid multiple expansion.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Unexpected inflation spikes in upcoming PCE data that could force the Fed to delay projected easing cycles.

marketLayer.title: Hong Kong EV & Automotive Supply Chains
marketLayer.fact: Leading Hong Kong-listed electric vehicle manufacturers reported steady July delivery volumes alongside expanding export shipments to Southeast Asian and European markets.
marketLayer.inference: International expansion strategies are increasingly becoming critical growth drivers to offset fierce price competition within the domestic Chinese EV market.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Imposition of elevated tariff barriers and regulatory hurdles in foreign destination markets.
